submit.title: Report content
submit.done: Report sent. Thanks for your feedback!
submit.duplicate: Your earlier report on this content is still being reviewed
submit.network: Could not send because of a connection error. Please try again.
submit.failed: Could not send the report, please try again

errors.fixSame: The correction is the same as the current content

list.search: Search by lesson or deck name

detail.noSnapshot: This report has no content snapshot
detail.rejectAll: Reject all reports from this student
detail.noHandlerNotice: No teacher can handle this report
detail.deletedNotice: The lesson or deck containing this content was deleted and may be restored
detail.resolveHint: Edit the content or apply a suggested fix first, then mark it resolved.

dialog.rejectAllBody: All unresolved reports from this student will be rejected. Other students' reports stay unchanged.
dialog.groupNote: Applies to all {{count}} reports in this row.
dialog.notFixed: {{fields}} has not changed since the report was received; edit it or reject the report
dialog.forbidden: You are not allowed to handle this report
dialog.network: Failed because of a connection error. Please try again.
dialog.failed: Something went wrong, please try again
dialog.takedownBody: "{{name}}" will go back to Draft and students will no longer see it. To republish, the teacher must fix the content and send a request for an admin to approve.
dialog.takedownCount: {{count}} reports will be closed with it.
dialog.takedownDone: Content taken down and reports closed

title.lesson: Lesson taken down by an admin
title.deck: Deck taken down by an admin

takedown.hint: Fix each reported item according to the takedown reason (including its image if the image was reported). Once all are fixed, you can ask an admin to approve republishing.
takedown.pending: Your republish request is waiting for admin approval.
takedown.readyHint: All reported items are fixed. Send a request for an admin to approve republishing.
takedown.stillUnfixed: Some reported items are still not fixed
takedown.manualHint: An admin took this content down. Fix it according to the reason, then send a request with a note describing what you changed.
takedown.noteTooLong: The note can be at most 500 characters

confirmBody.deck: The deck stays in Draft until an admin approves it; students only see it again after approval.
confirmBody.lesson: The lesson stays in Draft until an admin approves it; students only see it again after approval.

republish.title: Republish requests
republish.approved: Approved, the content is published again
republish.gone: This request is no longer valid
republish.notPublishable: The content can't be published yet (missing sentences or translations, or an empty card group). Reject the request so the teacher can fix it.

applyFix.title: Apply fix to {{field}}
applyFix.hint: The fix is written straight into the content. You still need to add a note and mark the report resolved.
applyFix.done: Fix applied. Add a note and mark the report resolved.
applyFix.wordTaken: This word already exists in the deck, so the fix can't be applied.
applyFix.invalid: The fix is longer than this field allows; edit it manually.
applyFix.gone: The report was already handled or the content was deleted
